people.name: Shri. Partha Pratim Pathak
people.evidence_quote: appointed Shri. Partha Pratim Pathak, (DIN: 02692935) as Non - Official Director (Independent Director) on the Board of Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) for a period of three (03) years from the date of appointment.
people.tenure_quote: For a period of three years from the date of appointment, or until further orders.
people.bio_quote: Shri Partha Pratim Pathak took charge as Independent Director of Navratna Defence PSU Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) today. He is a Promoter and Managing Director of Fresh Air Waste Management Services Private Limited and Director of Forcetech Energy Private Limited.
